verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a built-in AI assistant that 'answers based on your notes', supports AI chats where you pass specific blocks or notes as context, and proposes creates and updates that you approve. Data controls are covered by fully opt-in AI: no space data reaches third-party AI services unless you activate it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of summarization and drafting, granular controls beyond the opt-in switch and manual context passing (such as excluding specific notes or spaces), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
